firstLines: Sofia Marquez
Austin, TX | (512) 555-0153 | sofia.marquez@email.com | sofiamarquez.design/work
SUMMARY
Graphic designer with six years of brand, packaging and campaign work for food and beverage clients.
Comfortable taking a project from first sketch to print-ready files and working closely with copywriters.
EXPERIENCE
Senior Graphic Designer Feb 2023 – Present
Juniper & Vale Creative Austin, TX
• Led the packaging redesign for a regional coffee roaster across 18 products; retail sales rose 22% in the
first two quarters
• Built a brand system in Figma with type, color and layout rules that cut new campaign setup from a week
to two days
• Present concepts to clients and art direct two junior designers and one freelance illustrator
• Designed the agency's pitch template, used in 12 new business presentations last year
Graphic Designer Jun 2020 – Jan 2023
Rattlebrush Brewing Company San Antonio, TX
• Designed labels, tap handles and point-of-sale displays for 30 seasonal releases, all printed on schedule
• Prepared print files for three vendors and caught a color profile error that would have meant reprinting
40,000 labels
• Made social graphics and short motion pieces in After Effects that doubled average engagement on new
release posts
EDUCATION
Mesquite Hollow University San Marcos, TX
Bachelor of Fine Arts in Graphic Design May 2020
• Senior show: identity system for a fictional public library, chosen for the department's annual exhibition
SKILLS
Design: Brand identity, packaging, layout, typography, art direction
Software: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Figma, After Effects
Print: Prepress, color management, dielines, vendor proofs
Motion: After Effects, Premiere Pro, simple 2D animation
